name: digit_to_word
description: Map a single digit to its English cardinal or ordinal word, motivated by L28H0 value/output projections promoting four/fourth and seven/seventh. Controls copy the provided answer word.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
card=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine']; ordinal=['zeroth','first','second','third','fourth','fifth','sixth','seventh','eighth','ninth']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randrange(1,10); ord=i%2==0; word=(ordinal if ord else card)[n]; kind='ordinal' if ord else 'cardinal'
 prefix=random.choice(['Write the English {} word for this digit.','Convert the digit to its English {} word.','Give the English {} spelling of the digit.']).format(kind)
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nDigit: '+str(n)+'\nWord:','answer':' '+word})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nDigit: '+str(n)+'\nCopy this word: '+word+'\nWord:','answer':' '+word})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
